newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 895 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 895 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 895 contracts compared with 1,227 overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 244 wheat, 185 corn, 450 soybean, 14 soymeal, and two soyoil contracts traded. Five corn calls were traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 2-1/2 to 3-1/2 cents per bushel higher, corn was 3/4 to one cent higher and soybeans were three to five cents higher.
